package rulefixtures

import "runtime"

// scenario for go_perf_layer_garbage_collection_cleanup_finalizer_used_for_regular_cleanup: Layer: Garbage collection and cleanup. Flag runtime.SetFinalizer use for ordinary resource cleanup instead of explicit Close ownership.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
type scenario539Resource struct {
	fd int
}

func (r *scenario539Resource) Close() error {
	r.fd = -1
	return nil
}

func scenario539Positive(fd int) *scenario539Resource {
	r := &scenario539Resource{fd: fd}
	runtime.SetFinalizer(r, func(obj *scenario539Resource) {
		obj.Close()
	})
	return r
}
